_doc: Fixed camera poses for Gauntlet captures (--shots <dir>). pos is the player feet in Godot metres, yaw/pitch in degrees (yaw -90 faces +X along the course). Never move a pose between rounds; add a new row instead. weapon: a weapons.json id to hold for the picture ("(none)" holds whatever the pose starts with); lobby: true opens the aim lobby (round running, its HUD) at the pose.

rows.what: the Launch Site buildings from the checkpoint
end pad and ground texture at foot level
sky, sun and haze toward the horizon
aim lobby at the firing line: the numbered lanes, near bots in a rifle-ready stance, bots raised on crates, catwalks, the centre stage and the roofed back balcony, with the round HUD
rows.verified: 2026-10-09 rendered in lobby_r1_g3 (lobby Gauntlet round 1, this round): same pose; the range now has a raised centre stage (1.1 m, 17-23 m) with two bots on it and crate stacks either side, and a roofed balcony along the back wall (2.8 m) with three bots, under raised lane plaques; the fullmetal kit's facemask and plates read as grey steel; the gun is shown in its idle hold (the lobby cuts any draw clip to idle every frame of a capture)
